headlines.text: That Friday in 2023, the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Darby Allin vs. Mike Bennett went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.08 ? a good, competitive contest. Mike Bennett was challenging for gold for the very first time. This stood as the 60th match in AEW TNT Title history ? a genuinely rare milestone for that title. In his first defense of his second TNT Title reign, Allin outlasted a hard-hitting challenge from former WWE star Mike Bennett to retain the championship.

2021 brought us this moment: Kenny Omega vs. Rey Fenix went to battle over the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.88 ? a stone-cold classic. It was the first title opportunity of Rey Fenix's career. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

It was 2024 when Eddie Kingston vs. Trent Beretta went to battle over the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Collision, rated 7.39 ? a good, competitive contest. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2023, when Charlette Renegade laced up for their first AEW match against Britt Baker vs. Jamie Hayter vs. Robyn Renegade, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.06.

Turning the clock back to 2023: Orange Cassidy vs. Kip Sabian clashed for the AEW All-Atlantic Title, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.79. Kip Sabian was challenging for gold for the very first time.
Turning the clock back to 2024: The Kingdom was no more, reborn as The Undisputed Kingdom after 6 matches, on Collision.
